posts.title: Redwood + World Cup
posts.description: I got lucky presale world cup tickets for the US v Australia game in Seattle, so made a mini trip of it. On the drive north I stopped at Redwood NP to admire the big trees 🙄🌲 Then made my way up to Portland where I attended a river restoration course Monday-Thursday before the big game Friday. I picked up my buddy Chris from the airport and we got swagged out in our USA gear. The “Vegemite Free Zo

posts.title: Rocky Mountain
posts.description: Siblings trip to Colorado! The first night we saw one of my favorite bands, Flipturn, at red rocks. The next day we hiked in Rocky Mountain NP - crazy enough at the trailhead we happened to park next to the people we sat next to at the concert the night prior. Never tell me the odds. The following day we explored Denver and then were back in California before you knew it. Lexi wins award for most
